name: 4-FA
addictionPotential: moderately addictive with a high potential for abuse
summary: An empathogen commonly used in place of MDMA, having a similar duration of empathogenic effects. This drug, however, has a longer stimulant "tail," during which effects are more like those of amphetamines. Not to be confused with 4-FMA, which has a similar potency, but is not particularly empathogenic.
advisory: Avoid: Other stimulants and depressants. MXE is also to be avoided (possibility of serotonin syndrome). See combination information for more.
doseBasis: NOTE: Insufflating does not appear to provide a better bioavailability than oral ingestion, and can cause damage to nasal cavity.

pharmacology.text: 4-Fluoroamphetamine is a releasing agent and reuptake inhibitor of dopamine, serotonin, and norepinephrine. The respective EC50 values are 200 nM, 730 nM, and 37 nM, while the IC50 values are 770 nM, 6800 nM, and 420 nM.

uses.text: 4-FA was popular in the Netherlands where it was predominantly used for its specific effects (77% of users) rather than its legal status (18%). 4-FA has become illegal since May 2017. After it was banned, usage significantly decreased. Accurate statistics of usage are not available until 2020, but submitted samples to get tested were counted.

summaryZh: 4-氟苯丙胺，又稱對氟苯丙胺，是一種苯乙胺類和取代苯丙胺類精神活性研究化學品。它具有興奮和放心藥作用。作為一種娛樂性藥物，4-FA有時與2-氟苯丙胺和4-氟甲基苯丙胺等相關化合物一起出售。
summaryZhHans: 4-氟苯丙胺，又称对氟苯丙胺，是一种苯乙胺类和取代苯丙胺类精神活性研究化学品。它具有兴奋和放心药作用。作为一种娱乐性药物，4-FA有时与2-氟苯丙胺和4-氟甲基苯丙胺等相关化合物一起出售。

sideEffects.en: Common effects include a racing heart, raised blood pressure, jaw clenching, sweating, loss of appetite, insomnia and a low mood afterwards. In the Netherlands, where it was widely used, there were reports of strokes and bleeding in the brain linked to sharp rises in blood pressure, and a severe headache after use is a warning sign.
sideEffects.zh: 常見反應包括心跳急促、血壓升高、咬緊牙關、出汗、食慾不振、失眠，以及藥效過後的情緒低落。在曾經廣泛使用它的荷蘭，有與血壓急遽升高相關的中風與腦出血報告；使用後出現劇烈頭痛是危險警訊。
sideEffects.zhHans: 常见反应包括心跳急促、血压升高、咬紧牙关、出汗、食欲不振、失眠，以及药效过后的情绪低落。在曾经广泛使用它的荷兰，有与血压急遽升高相关的中风与脑出血报告；使用后出现剧烈头痛是危险警讯。

fact.en: 4-FA is amphetamine with one hydrogen atom on the benzene ring swapped for fluorine. Fluorine is barely larger than hydrogen, but it forms one of the strongest bonds in organic chemistry, which changes how the body breaks the drug down.
fact.zh: 4-FA就是把安非他命苯環上的一個氫原子換成氟。氟原子只比氫大一點點，卻能形成有機化學中最強的化學鍵之一，因而改變了身體分解這種藥物的方式。
fact.zhHans: 4-FA就是把安非他命苯环上的一个氢原子换成氟。氟原子只比氢大一点点，却能形成有机化学中最强的化学键之一，因而改变了身体分解这种药物的方式。
